model.admission: One actually willing perceived creature within120ft and LoE; willingness is checked at commitment and resolution. No forced Good/Lawful conversion or moral hierarchy.

cleansing.eligible: Active imposed alignment-alteration components whose type is alignment_override, whose source grants ordinary removable spell expression status, and whose exact protection resolver permits this rank9 cleansing. Bind the component IDs; unknown eligibility is not permission. All eligible components are ended once at success.
cleansing.operation: Call each affected source's actual end-component callback in stable component-ID order inside one transaction; cancel owned dependent operations only. Do not delete ledger entries.
cleansing.preserve: Underlying conduct/development, personality, oath obligations, acquisition and historical alignment records; independent Lock/Anchor snapshots and protected components survive unless their own accepted rule explicitly permits ending. No lower-source deletion erases a protected snapshot.

benefits.input: live effective permitted axes after completed cleansing; independent per-axis evaluation
benefits.unknownOrProtected: no benefit from that axis; no substitution of Neutral and no diagnostic disclosure
benefits.stacking: one modifier from each axis; typed Perfection bonuses never stack with another Perfection source. Other sources follow their own stacking rules.
benefits.valuePolicy: Every known Neutral axis has a concrete useful benefit. All values are new design selections, not native printed values.

lifecycle.cleansing: instantaneous completed source endings, not undone by later suppression or expiry
lifecycle.benefitSource: new continuing rank9 expression; no concentration; deadline successful resolution+1200000ms (20 minutes)
lifecycle.recast: later successful cast replaces benefit source; newly eligible alterations may end but old ended records are not ended twice. No consumable refill exists in this passive benefit model.
lifecycle.suppression: remove covered modifiers while original deadline runs; no cleansing restoration or missed-event benefits
lifecycle.death: ends target benefit source without changing corpse, gear or death history
lifecycle.legitimateChange: remove old axis modifiers and recompute before next affected event; spent movement remains spent when speed changes; no extra movement credit beyond shared recalculation rules
